title: Python security baseline
notes: Docket's own curated baseline, drawn from the weakness classes that OWASP, PyPA packaging guidance and the Bandit rule set all agree on, restated as controls a reader can check. Not a published standard and it does not claim to be one: `authority` is docket. Every control here is answerable by reading a Python repository, which is why the pack has no process entries.

controls.title: No credentials in source
controls.requirement: API keys, passwords, tokens and connection strings must be read from the environment or a secret store, never written into source or committed configuration.
controls.evidence_hint: string literals assigned to SECRET_KEY, PASSWORD, TOKEN, API_KEY; a committed .env with real values; settings modules with literal DSNs

controls.title: Dependencies pinned and locked
controls.requirement: Every dependency must be declared with an exact or bounded version and resolved through a committed lockfile, so a build is reproducible and a compromised upstream release cannot be pulled in silently.
controls.evidence_hint: requirements.txt with bare package names; pyproject.toml with no constraints; a missing uv.lock / poetry.lock / requirements.lock

controls.title: No dynamic evaluation of untrusted input
controls.requirement: eval, exec, compile and __import__ must not be reached with values derived from a request, a file, or any other untrusted source.
controls.evidence_hint: eval( / exec( / compile( anywhere; check whether the argument traces back to request data

controls.title: No unsafe deserialization
controls.requirement: pickle, marshal, shelve and dill must not load data that crossed a trust boundary. Use JSON or a schema-validated format for anything received.
controls.evidence_hint: pickle.load / pickle.loads / marshal.loads; a cache, queue or session backend configured with a pickle serializer

controls.title: YAML loaded safely
controls.requirement: YAML from any external source must be parsed with yaml.safe_load or an equivalent safe loader. yaml.load with the default loader constructs arbitrary Python objects.
controls.evidence_hint: yaml.load( without Loader=SafeLoader; yaml.unsafe_load; yaml.full_load on external input

controls.title: No shell string interpolation
controls.requirement: External commands must be invoked as an argument list with shell=False. A command assembled by string formatting with untrusted input is command injection.
controls.evidence_hint: subprocess with shell=True; os.system; os.popen; f-strings or % formatting inside a command string

controls.title: Parameterised database queries
controls.requirement: SQL must be built with bound parameters or an ORM's query API. Query text must never be assembled by string concatenation or formatting with request data.
controls.evidence_hint: cursor.execute with an f-string or % formatting; .raw( / text( with interpolation; SQLAlchemy text() built from request values

controls.title: Passwords hashed with a slow KDF
controls.requirement: Stored passwords must use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 with a per-user salt and a sane work factor. A general-purpose digest is not a password hash.
controls.citation: OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet; CWE-916
controls.evidence_hint: hashlib.md5/sha1/sha256 applied to a password; django/passlib/bcrypt/argon2 usage; a work factor left at a library minimum

controls.title: Cryptographic randomness for security values
controls.requirement: Tokens, session ids, password-reset codes and nonces must come from `secrets` or os.urandom. The `random` module is deterministic and predictable from observed output.
controls.evidence_hint: random.random / randint / choice / sample used to build a token, id, otp or salt

controls.title: Outbound TLS verified, with a timeout
controls.requirement: Outbound HTTP calls must verify certificates and must set a timeout. Disabling verification removes the only protection against an intercepting proxy.
controls.evidence_hint: requests/httpx calls with verify=False; ssl._create_unverified_context; urlopen with no timeout; requests.get with no timeout=

controls.title: Debug mode off and errors not leaked
controls.requirement: Debug and development modes must be off in any deployed configuration, and error responses must not carry stack traces, SQL, or configuration values to the client.
controls.evidence_hint: DEBUG = True; app.run(debug=True); FLASK_ENV=development; an error handler returning repr(exc) or traceback.format_exc()

controls.title: Template autoescaping enabled
controls.requirement: HTML templates must autoescape by default, and any explicit unescaping must be applied to values that are not attacker-controlled.
controls.evidence_hint: jinja2.Environment without autoescape=True; |safe, mark_safe, Markup( applied to request data; render_template_string on user input

controls.title: No security checks written as assert
controls.requirement: Authorisation, validation and invariant checks must not be expressed with `assert`: the interpreter removes every assert under -O, so the check silently disappears in an optimised deployment.
controls.evidence_hint: assert statements in request handlers, permission helpers or validators, as opposed to in tests

controls.title: Temporary files created safely
controls.requirement: Temporary files must be created atomically with tempfile.mkstemp or NamedTemporaryFile. A predictable path in a shared directory is a symlink race.

controls.title: XML parsed without external entities
controls.requirement: XML from an external source must be parsed with defusedxml or with external entity and DTD processing explicitly disabled.
controls.evidence_hint: xml.etree.ElementTree, minidom, lxml.etree.fromstring or SAX parsers applied to request or upload data with no resolve_entities=False

controls.title: User-supplied paths contained
controls.requirement: A filename or path from a request must be resolved and then checked to be inside the intended directory, by parent traversal rather than by a string prefix comparison.
controls.evidence_hint: open(), send_file(), os.path.join() reached by a request value; a startswith() containment check; no .resolve() before the check

controls.title: Secrets absent from logs
controls.requirement: Logging must not record passwords, tokens, card numbers, full request bodies or authorization headers, including in exception handlers that serialise a whole request.
controls.evidence_hint: logger calls with request.form, request.json, request.headers or an auth token; print of a credential; exception handlers logging locals()

controls.title: Outbound URLs from requests are constrained
controls.requirement: Where the application fetches a URL that a client influenced, the destination must be validated against an allowlist and redirects must not be followed to unvalidated hosts.
controls.evidence_hint: requests/httpx/urlopen whose URL comes from request data; webhook, import-from-url, avatar-fetch or link-preview features; missing allow_redirects=False
